- Do you support a hybrid setup (2 people on-site, the rest remote) and can we do selective screen sharing/recording?

Hi Sarah — great to hear you're ready. We can absolutely run hybrid and support selective screen share; recording is allowed only with explicit customer consent and Redwood security sign-off (I flagged that below).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Mar 16, 09:00–13:00 (4h block)
- Wed Mar 17, 09:00–13:00 (4h block)
- Thu Mar 18, 10:00–14:00 (4h block)

Agenda (draft) attached: POC_Agenda_v2.pdf — short prompt review, routing configuration, 15–20m load test run (we'll scale from 100tpm -> target 10k tokens/min), then runbook review and next steps. Please confirm which day and whether you'll have 2 onsite engineers (names) so we can arrange visitor badges.

Pre-reqs:
- Sandbox credentials (we'll send by secure link once date is locked)
- VPN access to the private VPC for remote participants (temporary creds)
- Test dataset: CSV of 500–2k example prompts is ideal for routing checks

Marissa — can you confirm availability of Room B-3 (AV + 2x HDMI + conference bridge) for the 3 proposed windows?
Dylan — can you advise what we need from Acme for visitor onboarding and whether the session can be recorded (security needs an explicit request + joint sign-off)?

Thanks — I'll hold the proposed slots tentatively until I hear back.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa — Room B-3 is available on Mar 17, 09:00–13:00. I reserved it tentatively and scheduled an AV dry-run on Mar 16 at 16:00. Attached is the room layout and guest list template for on-site names.

Visitor onboarding checklist (for Acme):
- Full name, company email, photo ID (driver's license or passport) — we need this 48h in advance for badges.
- NDA: not required for building access but recommended for any recorded session; we can arrange a one-page mutual NDA if they ask to record.
- Building access: Acme visitors must sign in at lobby; internal host (Vanessa) must escort them.

Recording policy (Dylan can confirm): security will allow recording only after a signed consent (customer + Redwood) and a brief config check on the AV side. Expect 24–48h approval.
